intro: Razormaw Needling is a Wetlands quest where Howin Kindfeather tasks travelers with harvesting incisors from local Razormaw raptors. Howin aims to fashion durable awls from their sharp teeth in order to pierce and stitch together dragon whelp scales for flame-resistant armor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.
I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.
These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.
The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.
Bring me a handful of the incisors.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any luck prying those teeth off? I need 'em whole so they don't snap on the scales right away.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These'll make a beautiful set of awls. Thank ye.
